description: Hotfix 3.12.1 of the prod-gate (D-43): a prod approval is bound to the change the human's phrase names; an approval in the repo that owns a change covers the [Deploy] <id> PRs of the repos it declares; REST calls that complete a PR or approve a production pipeline, and commands run outside a repo, pass the same SHA-bound gate; a read-only listing of the state paths is not blocked (BL-64).
goal: A production approval reaches exactly the change and the commits the human approved, whatever repo, working tree or command form the release goes through.
security_tier_reason: changes the approval hook and the prod-gate, the guards that stand between an agent and a production merge
